title: fix(retry): honor the retryAfter option in the default retry strategy
author: codeAnqiang-ma

ticket.title: fix(retry): honor the retryAfter option in the default retry strategy

spotlights.label: Only a literal false turns it off
spotlights.why: The check is retryAfter === false. null and undefined become true in the constructor (?? true), but 0, an empty string or the string "false" still let the header decide the wait.

spotlights.label: Callers who set false now retry sooner
spotlights.why: retryAfter: false used to do nothing, so code that set it was still waiting as long as the server asked (up to maxTimeout, 30 s by default). It now waits only minTimeout * timeoutFactor ** (counter - 1), so a rate-limited server sees retries earlier than before.

spotlights.label: A custom retry function is not covered
spotlights.why: Only the default strategy reads the flag. A retryOptions.retry function still gets retryOptions.retryAfter and has to honour it itself, as before.

spotlights.label: One case tested, on the handler alone
spotlights.why: The new test calls onResponseError directly with fake timers: a 429 with retry-after: 60. A zero or HTTP-date header, a real server, and the RetryAgent and interceptors.retry() paths have no new test, and the PR body says the full suite was not run.

steps.title: Skip the Retry-After header when retryAfter is false
steps.why: The default retry strategy, RetryHandler[kRetryHandlerDefaultRetry], now reads retryAfter from retryOptions. When it is exactly false the header is treated as absent, so the wait falls through to the exponential backoff.
steps.consequence: retryAfter: false now does what RetryHandler.md and the type docs say, for RetryHandler, RetryAgent and interceptors.retry(). With the default (true) nothing changes.

hunks.patch:
diff --git a/lib/handler/retry-handler.js b/lib/handler/retry-handler.js
index c098b510c26..b8111ebea24 100644
--- a/lib/handler/retry-handler.js
+++ b/lib/handler/retry-handler.js
@@ -190,7 +190,8 @@ class RetryHandler {
       timeoutFactor,
       statusCodes,
       errorCodes,
-      methods
+      methods,
+      retryAfter
     } = retryOptions
     const { counter } = state
 
@@ -222,7 +223,7 @@ class RetryHandler {
       return
     }
 
-    let retryAfterHeader = headers?.['retry-after']
+    let retryAfterHeader = retryAfter === false ? undefined : headers?.['retry-after']
     if (retryAfterHeader) {
       retryAfterHeader = Number(retryAfterHeader)
       retryAfterHeader = Number.isNaN(retryAfterHeader)

notes.text: Stored as retryAfter ?? true, never read before
Strict: only false skips the header

steps.title: Prove a 60 s Retry-After is ignored when the option is off
steps.why: A 429 with retry-after: 60 and retryAfter: false goes straight to onResponseError. After 500 ms of fake time the retry must already have been dispatched.
steps.consequence: Fails at the base (the retry would wait 30 s, capped by maxTimeout) and passes with the fix; the zero-second header and date form are not tested.
